entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need some help with a return. I bought a jersey a little while back and it doesn't fit.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Thank you. I have the order pulled up here for the Aero Race Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's just the wrong size for me. I finally got a chance to try it on for a real ride and it's just way too tight. I was hoping I could exchange it for a larger size.
I see. So the fit isn't right. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 59 days ago. One moment while I confirm our policy.

Alright, thank you for waiting. Because the jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.

Oh, fantastic. That's great news. Thank you for making that so easy. Since I will be re-ordering the same jersey in a different size, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for the new purchase, just for the trouble of having to send this one back?

I understand your request, and I'm glad we could get the return sorted out for you. While I can't offer a discount code for a wrong size exchange, the return shipping is completely free with the label I've sent. Once we receive the original item, your refund will be processed automatically.
I see. Well, it was worth asking. Free return shipping is good enough. I'll get that sent back this week. Thanks again for your help.
You're very welcome! The instructions will be in the email with the label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
